name: Asher
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Asher is the so-called Incan Indians of South America, dwelling in the places from Colombia on down. Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties: Asher is known for resources, an abundance of natural riches in his land.
The blessing of Moses says the same of Asher: let him dip his foot in oil.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali were to stand upon mount Ebal to curse. Half the tribes stood on one side and half on the other, one saying one thing and the other answering.

note.label: Deuteronomy 27: Write the Law upon Stones

points: Let Asher dip his foot in oil; his shoes shall be iron and brass. South America is known for oil, and Brazil means iron. The Lord made no mistake in where he placed Asher.

Let Asher be blessed with children, let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil. Asher runs from Colombia to Uruguay, and the scattered tribes of the Amazon need their brethren to reach them.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

points: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children. Asher is also a large tribe: the countries that make up Asher today include Brazil, Peru, Colombia, and Uruguay, and Brazil has the largest population of children in the world.

note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

points: The coast descended to the river Kanah: southward of the river the cities were Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, the sea was his border, and they met together in Asher on the north and in Issachar on the east.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim

points: Manasseh also had within Issachar and Asher the cities of Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor, En-dor, Taanach, and Megiddo with their towns, even three countries.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim

points: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families; their border reached to Carmel westward, up to great Zidon and to the strong city Tyre, twenty and two cities with their villages.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali; their coast reached to Zebulun on the south side, to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising, meaning the east.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities out of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, and the children of Merari had twelve cities out of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun; all given by lot as the Most High commanded by the hand of Moses.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts and great searchings of heart: they were second-guessing themselves. Gilead abode beyond Jordan, Dan remained in ships, and Asher continued on the seashore; the song is getting on the tribes that stayed home.

note.label: Judges 5: The Song of Deborah and Barak: A Willing People

points: The Levites had no land inheritance like the rest of the tribes, so these cities and their suburbs are where they dwelt, given out of Judah, Simeon, Benjamin, Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: The sons of Asher are named, and their line is traced through the heads of their fathers' houses.
Asher were warriors too, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes, numbered twenty and six thousand men fit for the battle.
From the east side to the west side the portions are given in order: Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, and Judah, each by the border of the one before.
